name: mark2-fip-radio
description: Turn a Mycroft Mark II into a FIP internet radio (now-playing screen, LED volume ring, quiet fan) on stock Raspberry Pi OS — no custom image.
author: jeffehobbs

setup_notes.heading: Install
setup_notes.content:
On the Mark II (or over SSH):

git clone https://github.com/jeffehobbs/mark2-fip-radio
cd mark2-fip-radio
sudo ./install.sh
sudo reboot

After the reboot it comes up playing FIP with the now-playing screen. To remove
everything: `sudo ./uninstall.sh`.
